name: 79121 · Amarillo, TX
findings: ZIP 79121 (Amarillo) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79121 (Amarillo) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 79121 (Amarillo) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 37% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.
